text: Suppressions Automatic acknowledgement One "we have your message" reply to a customer who opens a ticket by email. Send an acknowledgement This is the default for departments that have not set the “Receiving a new ticket” rule under Customization → Notifications; a department’s own rule there decides on its own. With this default, only addresses with "Acknowledge mail to this address" turned on send it. It goes to the address the mail came from, not the From line. A first-time sender we can't authenticate gets none, and each sender gets at most a few an hour. Wording {{ticket_number}} and {{subject}} are filled in. An empty box restores the default wording rather than sending an empty message. Save Where the quoted message goes A reply carries the message it answers, quoted. This is where the agent's own words sit relative to it. The ticket itself always shows each message once. Agent's reply on top What most email clients do. Agent's reply underneath The conversation reads oldest first.
